say:1:1730204801:1.text: *Squeak* There are two bird guys over there!
say:1:1730204801:1.source_cn: 吱吱，前面有两个鹰人好可怕的！
say:1:1730204801:1.male: *Squeak* There are two bird guys over there!
say:1:1730204801:1.female: *Squeak* There are two bird guys over there!

say:2:1730204802:1.text: *Squeak* One of them has broken wings, and the other is too injured to keep going!
say:2:1730204802:1.source_cn: 吱吱，他们一个折断了翅膀，另一个受了重伤不想再逃！
say:2:1730204802:1.male: *Squeak* One of them has broken wings, and the other is too injured to keep going!
say:2:1730204802:1.female: *Squeak* One of them has broken wings, and the other is too injured to keep going!

say:3:1730204803:1.text: *Squeak* There's blood all around them! I have to go before the falcons and the wolves get here!
say:3:1730204803:1.source_cn: 吱吱，他们的四周都是血的味道，鹰和狼很快就会闻到的！鼠...
say:3:1730204803:1.male: *Squeak* There's blood all around them! I have to go before the falcons and the wolves get here!
say:3:1730204803:1.female: *Squeak* There's blood all around them! I have to go before the falcons and the wolves get here!
